title: Plan Credit on the Re-Rated Premium of a Realigned Named Non-Owner Policy Term
content:
**Plan credit.** On a Named Non-Owner Policy term realigned for a DUI requirement, the billing plan of the term sets a credit on the re-rated full-term premium.

| Billing plan of the term (Installment Payment Plans) | Plan credit |
|---|---|
| Cardinal Point Paid-in-Full Plan | 0.94 |
| Cardinal Point Monthly EFT Plan | 0.97 |
| Cardinal Point Monthly Card Autopay Plan | 0.97 |
| Two-Pay, Four-Pay, Six-Pay Direct Bill or any other plan | none |

The credit multiplies the re-rated full-term premium before that figure is rounded to the cent; every other plan carries no such credit.
